modmenu.summaryTranslation.locator_lodes: Adds Lodestones t' th' Sailing Crew Locator Bar, ye scurvy dog!
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.locator_l:
Adds Lodestones t' th' Sailing Crew Locator Bar.

Lodestone Compasses in yer Treasure Chest (includin' in Bundles, arr!) add Waymarks t' yer Locator Bar.
configs.locator_lodestones.tab_display.t: Whether holdin' th' tab key forces th' locator bar t' show, be needed fer it t' show, or does nothin' (aye, default)
configs.locator_lodestones.tab_shows_nam: Whether holdin' th' tab key makes th' names o' compass waymarks appear, arr!
configs.locator_lodestones.show_recovery: Whether Salvage Compasses also conjure waymarks
configs.locator_lodestones.show_bundled_: Whether compasses stashed in Bundles also show
configs.locator_lodestones.show_in_spect: Whether compass waymarks still show in Ghost (Spectator) Mode, arr!
configs.locator_lodestones.color_customi: Whether th' paint o' waymarks can be changed by scribblin' a hex code in th' trinket name
configs.locator_lodestones.lodestone_col: Th' usual paint fer Lodestone Compass waymarks. Set t' 'random' t' roll th' dice o' fate
configs.locator_lodestones.recovery_colo: Th' usual paint fer Salvage Compass waymarks. Set t' 'random' t' roll th' dice o' fate
